en.title: Steam in the Tenement and the Bond of a Nameless Cat
en.premise: Genzaburo is a skilled carpenter with a sharp tongue. One day, he discovers a mysterious "iron box that breathes steam" of unknown origin. As the residents of the tenement are swept up in the chaos of this strange machine and their pursuit of efficiency, a nameless calico cat remains a constant companion. As the true nature of the machine and the poignant wish hidden within are revealed, a wave of warmth and tears washes over the town of Edo.

zh.title: 長屋的蒸汽與無名貓的緣分
zh.premise: 手藝精湛但口才糟糕的木匠源三郎，某天撿到了一個來源不明、會「噴出蒸汽的不思議鐵箱」。長屋的居民們被這台奇妙的機器搞得團團轉，在追求效率的過程中陷入了一場大騷動，而身邊始終陪伴著一隻無名的三色貓。隨著機器的真面目以及其中蘊含的悲切願望逐漸揭曉，江戶之町流下了溫暖的淚水。
